id_scheme: DOMAIN-NN, where DOMAIN is a stable four-to-five letter code and NN is a two-digit sequence within that domain.

domains.name: Mathematical Foundations for Machine Learning
domains.purpose: Provide the linear algebra, calculus, probability and optimisation that machine learning methods are built from, taught with the derivations and geometric interpretations needed to reason rather than memorise.
domains.notes: The supplied book covers this domain directly for chapters 2-7 and indirectly through its machine-learning chapters 8-12. Numerical linear algebra and floating-point behaviour are touched on but not taught systematically; that is recorded as a supplemental need rather than assumed.

domains.name: Programming and Software Craft
domains.purpose: Write, structure, debug, test and version Python programs to a professional standard, which is the substrate for every later domain.
domains.notes: No source supplied yet. The roadmap nominates a book and two courses per skill; those are recorded as intended sources pending the user's own copies.

domains.name: Algorithms, Data Structures and Numeric Computing
domains.purpose: Choose and analyse data structures and algorithms, and use vectorised numeric computing correctly, including knowing when vectorisation changes the result.

domains.name: Data Engineering
domains.purpose: Move, store, model, transform and validate data reliably, which determines whether any downstream model can be trusted.
domains.notes: No source supplied yet. SQL is exercised indirectly by the supplied book's modelling chapters, but query language competence itself is not taught there.

domains.name: Software and Systems Engineering
domains.purpose: Design, containerise, secure, deploy and operate services, including the distributed-systems reasoning that production AI systems depend on.

domains.name: Classical Machine Learning
domains.purpose: Formulate learning problems, choose baselines, train and validate models, and evaluate them honestly.
domains.notes: The supplied book covers linear regression, PCA, Gaussian mixture models, support vector machines and the estimation/evaluation theory that connects them (chapters 8-12). It does not cover tree ensembles, gradient boosting, or the practical tooling ecosystem.

domains.name: Deep Learning
domains.purpose: Build, train, diagnose and scale neural networks, including the transformer architecture that current language and vision systems rely on.
domains.notes: The supplied book supplies the mathematics of backpropagation and the linear-algebraic machinery transformers are built from, but not the architectures, training practice or frameworks. Supplemental sources required.

domains.name: Generative AI and LLM Applications
domains.purpose: Build applications on top of large models: prompting, retrieval, adaptation, agents, and the evaluation needed to know whether any of it works.
domains.notes: No source supplied yet. This is the fastest-moving domain in the roadmap, so version-sensitive claims will be dated and re-checked rather than stated once.

domains.name: Production AI Engineering, Reliability and Responsibility
domains.purpose: Run AI systems in production: deployment, monitoring, cost, incident response, security, privacy and responsible-AI obligations.
domains.notes: No source supplied yet. The roadmap treats this as two skills; the competency audit treats it as the largest gap between the roadmap and what employers screen for, so it is held as one domain with several uncovered competencies.

domains.name: Professional Practice and Career Development
domains.purpose: Communicate technical work, collaborate on code, prepare for interviews honestly, and keep knowledge current.
domains.notes: Not represented as named skills in either roadmap beyond the two project sprints and the capstone. Recorded as a domain so that project and interview preparation are not silently dropped.
